item.title: Military academies now accept Classical Learning Test as alternative to ‘woke’ AP exams
item.description: The Classical Learning Test, endorsed by Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, is gaining traction as an alternative to traditional exams like the SAT, ACT, and AP.

item.title: Utah bill would allow religious accommodations for class assignments
item.description: A Utah bill would create religious exemptions for assignments in required college courses.

item.title: Ohio State University professor on leave after tackling independent documentarian
item.description: 'We are aware of the incident, and it is very concerning': OSU spokesman

item.title: ‘Sexual harassment’ at Michigan State includes ‘offensive’ words
item.description: Michigan State University commissioned a survey that is replete with bad definitions and funky data.

item.title: Women need abortions to make more money, scholars argue
item.description: Pro-life laws are bad because women might make less money if they don't abort their babies, professors argue.

item.title: U. Iowa student allegedly assaults GOP lawmaker at DEI hearing. She denies it.
item.description: University of Iowa grad student Abigail Escatel denied assaulting GOP Rep. Steve Holt during a hearing Monday on a bill restricting DEI in higher education.

item.title: Syracuse faculty demand ‘transparency’ after false reports of ICE on campus
item.description: Why didn't the school tell everyone that ICE was not on campus, professors wonder.

item.title: UT Austin to merge gender, African, Latina/Latino studies departments
item.description: UT Austin is merging several departments, including women’s, gender, and African studies. President Jim Davis cited factors like academic mission and resource allocation. However, one professor condemned the move as an "authoritarian takeover."
